name: King of Romance
subject: Yash Raj Films
tagline: Eleven questions on the studio behind Bollywood's biggest love stories, from Swiss meadows to a cinema that never stopped showing one film. A theme the group suggested.

questions.q: Yash Raj Films, for decades the most powerful studio in Hindi cinema, was founded in 1970 by which Lahore-born director, nicknamed the King of Romance?
questions.w: Yash Chopra, who began as an assistant to his elder brother and went on to direct more than twenty films before his death in 2012. The studio's first production under its own name was Daag in 1973.
questions.more: Chopra was born in 1932 in Lahore, before Partition, and moved to what became India as a young man. He won the Dadasaheb Phalke Award, India's highest film honour, in 2001. The company is now run by his son Aditya, who gives almost no interviews.

questions.q: Which 1995 film, Aditya Chopra's directorial debut, played at the Maratha Mandir cinema for more than a quarter of a century, until theatres shut in March 2020?
questions.w: Dilwale Dulhania Le Jayenge, usually shortened to DDLJ. It is often called the longest continuous theatrical run in Indian cinema.
questions.more: Aditya Chopra wrote and directed it in his early twenties, and its lovers Raj and Simran travel across Europe on a Eurail pass before the story moves to a Punjab village. The scene of Simran running to catch Raj's hand on a moving train is among the most copied in Indian film.

questions.q: Yash Chopra's romances made which European country such a dream destination that its tourist board gave him a statue in Interlaken?
questions.w: Switzerland, whose meadows, lakes and railways he used as the backdrop for song sequences from the 1980s onwards. Swiss officials credited him with bringing generations of Indian visitors.
questions.more: Indian tourist numbers to Switzerland rose sharply after his films, and a bronze statue of him was unveiled in Interlaken in 2016, four years after his death. Songs shot among the Alps became so common that audiences joked a film wasn't romantic until the cast reached the snow.

questions.q: Which superstar returned to the screen in 2023 as an exiled secret agent in Pathaan, the film that began Yash Raj's 'spy universe' and earned over 1,000 crore rupees worldwide?
questions.w: Shah Rukh Khan, in his first leading role in four years. He has starred in many of Yash Raj's biggest films, and the studio's spy franchise has since added War and Tiger 3.
questions.more: Pathaan was released in January 2023 and grossed more than a thousand crore rupees worldwide despite calls to boycott it before release. Khan has been called the King of Bollywood for decades. He is also among the richest actors in the world, with a fortune estimated at well over a billion dollars.

questions.q: Which actor plays the Indian spy Avinash 'Tiger' Rathore, who first appeared in Yash Raj's 2012 film Ek Tha Tiger?
questions.w: Salman Khan. The film grew into a franchise with Tiger Zinda Hai in 2017 and Tiger 3 in 2023, and Tiger now shares a screen universe with Pathaan.
questions.more: Kabir Khan directed the first film, a spy romance between an Indian agent and a Pakistani one, which was the highest-grossing Hindi film of 2012. In Tiger 3, Shah Rukh Khan appeared as Pathaan in a guest role, the first crossover of the spy universe. Salman Khan has been among India's biggest box-office draws since the late 1980s.

questions.q: Yash Chopra's 1975 gangster drama Deewaar, written by Salim–Javed, cemented which actor as Hindi cinema's 'angry young man'?
questions.w: Amitabh Bachchan, who plays the dockworker turned smuggler Vijay opposite his policeman brother, played by Shashi Kapoor. The line 'Mere paas maa hai' ('I have mother') is one of the most quoted in Hindi film.
questions.more: Chopra and Bachchan made several films together, among them Kabhie Kabhie in 1976 and Silsila in 1981, where Bachchan's real-life wife Jaya and rumoured lover Rekha played the women in his love triangle. Deewaar was later remade in several languages, including Tamil and Telugu. Bachchan is still working in his eighties.

questions.q: Aditya Chopra, head of Yash Raj Films, married which actress in a private ceremony in Italy in 2014?
questions.w: Rani Mukerji, a Yash Raj regular who starred in Hum Tum, Bunty Aur Babli and Mardaani. They had a daughter, Adira, in 2015.
questions.more: The wedding was kept secret until it had happened, with the couple announcing it afterwards. Mukerji won her first Filmfare Best Actress award for Hum Tum in 2005 and later played a tough policewoman in the Mardaani films. Aditya Chopra is famously media-shy, and the couple rarely appear in public together.

questions.q: Which film, Yash Chopra's last as director, starring Shah Rukh Khan, Katrina Kaif and Anushka Sharma, was released three weeks after his death in October 2012?
questions.w: Jab Tak Hai Jaan, which he had said would be his last film as director. He died of dengue on 21 October 2012 at the age of 80.
questions.more: The film opened on Diwali weekend, going head to head with Ajay Devgn's Son of Sardaar, and A. R. Rahman composed the music. Chopra's career had started in 1959, more than fifty years earlier. The film is now seen as a farewell from a director who defined the Bollywood romance.

questions.q: Yash Chopra's first film as director, Dhool Ka Phool in 1959, was made under the banner of which elder brother, whose own films included Naya Daur and the television series Mahabharat?
questions.w: B. R. Chopra, who ran B. R. Films and gave his younger brother his start. Yash left to form his own company in 1970 after his brother's success.
questions.more: Dhool Ka Phool, about an abandoned baby raised by a Muslim man, was a social drama very different from the romances Yash Chopra later became known for. B. R. Chopra's 1988 television version of the Mahabharat drew audiences so large that streets in India emptied during its Sunday-morning broadcast. His son Ravi Chopra continued the family's film business.

questions.q: Put these Yash Chopra and Yash Raj films in the order they were released, earliest first.
questions.w: Deewaar in 1975, Chandni in 1989, Dilwale Dulhania Le Jayenge in 1995 and Pathaan in 2023.
questions.more: Chandni, starring Sridevi in white, was one of the biggest musical romances of its decade and relaunched the director's career after a run of flops. DDLJ followed six years later. Pathaan, nearly three decades after that, marked a turn from romances to action franchises.

questions.q: Which of these films were produced by Yash Raj Films? Select all that apply.
questions.w: Dhoom, Bunty Aur Babli and Band Baaja Baaraat were all Yash Raj productions. Kuch Kuch Hota Hai came from Dharma Productions, Lagaan from Aamir Khan Productions and Dangal from Disney and Aamir Khan.
questions.more: Dhoom launched a bike-heist franchise and a pair of sequels, and Band Baaja Baaraat, a wedding-planner romance, introduced Ranveer Singh in 2010. Yash Raj Films also set up a talent agency and a separate film studio in Mumbai's suburbs. The rival banners listed here have shaped the other main strands of Hindi cinema.
